problem_text:
A shipping company must transport seven categories of cargo, each requiring seven sequential handling stages to be prepared for delivery.  
The revenue generated per ton of each cargo category is listed below:  
* For Cargo Alpha, revenue is 12.49 per ton  
* For Cargo Beta, revenue is 6.65 per ton  
* For Cargo Gamma, revenue is 10.759 per ton  
* For Cargo Delta, revenue is 10.831 per ton  
* For Cargo Epsilon, revenue is 12.703 per ton  
* For Cargo Zeta, revenue is 19.701 per ton  
* For Cargo Eta, revenue is 19.65 per ton  

Handling duration required per ton for each stage is as follows:  
* For Cargo Alpha, Stage 1 consumes 1.219 (ton-hours), Stage 2 consumes 1.313 (ton-hours), Stage 3 consumes 1.416 (ton-hours), Stage 4 consumes 1.104 (ton-hours), Stage 5 consumes 1.076 (ton-hours), Stage 6 consumes 0.766 (ton-hours), Stage 7 consumes 1.431 (ton-hours)  
* For Cargo Beta, Stage 1 consumes 0.365 (ton-hours), Stage 2 consumes 0.771 (ton-hours), Stage 3 consumes 1.804 (ton-hours), Stage 4 consumes 0.609 (ton-hours), Stage 5 consumes 1.942 (ton-hours), Stage 6 consumes 1.972 (ton-hours), Stage 7 consumes 1.236 (ton-hours)  
* For Cargo Gamma, Stage 1 consumes 0.273 (ton-hours), Stage 2 consumes 0.368 (ton-hours), Stage 3 consumes 0.561 (ton-hours), Stage 4 consumes 0.788 (ton-hours), Stage 5 consumes 0.404 (ton-hours), Stage 6 consumes 1.635 (ton-hours), Stage 7 consumes 0.855 (ton-hours)  
* For Cargo Delta, Stage 1 consumes 0.621 (ton-hours), Stage 2 consumes 0.279 (ton-hours), Stage 3 consumes 0.889 (ton-hours), Stage 4 consumes 0.208 (ton-hours), Stage 5 consumes 0.41 (ton-hours), Stage 6 consumes 1.288 (ton-hours), Stage 7 consumes 1.883 (ton-hours)  
* For Cargo Epsilon, Stage 1 consumes 0.559 (ton-hours), Stage 2 consumes 1.534 (ton-hours), Stage 3 consumes 0.556 (ton-hours), Stage 4 consumes 0.203 (ton-hours), Stage 5 consumes 1.814 (ton-hours), Stage 6 consumes 1.723 (ton-hours), Stage 7 consumes 0.32 (ton-hours)  
* For Cargo Zeta, Stage 1 consumes 0.519 (ton-hours), Stage 2 consumes 0.622 (ton-hours), Stage 3 consumes 1.871 (ton-hours), Stage 4 consumes 0.887 (ton-hours), Stage 5 consumes 1.653 (ton-hours), Stage 6 consumes 0.984 (ton-hours), Stage 7 consumes 0.886 (ton-hours)  
* For Cargo Eta, Stage 1 consumes 1.578 (ton-hours), Stage 2 consumes 1.308 (ton-hours), Stage 3 consumes 0.685 (ton-hours), Stage 4 consumes 1.249 (ton-hours), Stage 5 consumes 1.467 (ton-hours), Stage 6 consumes 1.689 (ton-hours), Stage 7 consumes 1.419 (ton-hours)  

Available handling capacity in ton-hours for each stage is strictly limited:  
* Stage 1’s total handling duration cannot exceed 145.784  
* Stage 2’s total handling duration cannot exceed 135.216  
* Stage 3’s total handling duration cannot exceed 193.493  
* Stage 4’s total handling duration cannot exceed 150.777  
* Stage 5’s total handling duration cannot exceed 165.412  
* Stage 6’s total handling duration cannot exceed 247.036  
* Stage 7’s total handling duration cannot exceed 185.129  

Provided that each handling stage—Stage 1 through Stage 7—does not surpass its allocated time budget, determine the optimal tonnage of each cargo category to transport in order to maximize total revenue.
